@@ -11,5 +11,41 @@ class CountLinesTest(unittest.TestCase):
         self.assertEqual(count_lines(""), 0)
 
 
+class WordCountTest(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_empty_and_whitespace_only(self):
+        for value in ("", " ", "   ", "\t\n\r\f\v", "\u00a0\u2003\u202f"):
+            with self.subTest(value=value):
+                self.assertEqual(word_count(value), 0)
+
+    def test_single_and_multiple_words(self):
+        for value, expected in (("hello", 1), ("hello world", 2), ("one two three four", 4)):
+            with self.subTest(value=value):
+                self.assertEqual(word_count(value), expected)
+
+    def test_leading_trailing_and_repeated_spaces(self):
+        self.assertEqual(word_count("   one    two   three   "), 3)
+        self.assertEqual(word_count("   alone   "), 1)
+
+    def test_ascii_whitespace_separators(self):
+        for separator in (" ", "\t", "\n", "\r", "\f", "\v", "\r\n"):
+            with self.subTest(separator=separator):
+                self.assertEqual(word_count("one" + separator + "two"), 2)
+        self.assertEqual(word_count("\t one\n\r two\f\vthree \t"), 3)
+
+    def test_unicode_whitespace_separators(self):
+        for separator in ("\u00a0", "\u2003", "\u202f", "\u3000", "\u2028", "\u2029"):
+            with self.subTest(separator=separator):
+                self.assertEqual(word_count("one" + separator + "two"), 2)
+
+    def test_punctuation_does_not_split_words(self):
+        self.assertEqual(word_count("hello,world!"), 1)
+        self.assertEqual(word_count("don't re-enter snake_case 3.14 !!!"), 5)
+
+    def test_non_whitespace_characters_stay_in_words(self):
+        for value in ("你好世界", "hello\u200bworld", "a\x00b", "🙂🚀"):
+            with self.subTest(value=value):
+                self.assertEqual(word_count(value), 1)
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
